name: Adventurer Trainer
source:
Adventurer Trainer is a free non-commercial fan-made porn-parody Dating Sim/Visual Novel with RPG elements, set in a fictional universe loosely based on Konosuba and other titles. You will meet familiar characters, embark on exhilarating adventures, solve mysteries and more!

[From [url=https://www.patreon.com/adventurertrainer]Patreon[/url]]
translation:
《冒险者训练师》（Adventurer Trainer）是一款免费非商业性质的同人恶搞成人恋爱模拟/视觉小说游戏，融合了RPG元素，故事背景设定在以《为美好的世界献上祝福！》等多部作品为蓝本构建的架空世界中。在这里，你将邂逅耳熟能详的角色，踏上扣人心弦的冒险旅途，解开重重谜团，体验更多精彩内容！

[摘自[url=https://www.patreon.com/adventurertrainer]Patreon[/url]]
